mapper.select: SELECT CAST(id AS CHAR) FROM tc_warehouse WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND warehouse_no=#{warehouseNo}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tc_inventory_balance(tenant_id,warehouse_id,sku_id) VALUES (#{tenant},#{warehouseId},#{skuId}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE id=id
mapper.update: UPDATE tc_inventory_balance SET available=available+#{availableDelta},stock_total=stock_total+#{totalDelta},version=version+1 WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND warehouse_id=#{warehouseId} AND sku_id=#{skuId} AND available>=#{minimumAvailable}

UPDATE tc_inventory_balance SET available=available-#{availableDelta},reserved=reserved+#{reservedDelta},version=version+1 WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND warehouse_id=#{warehouseId} AND sku_id=#{skuId} AND available>=#{minimumAvailable}
mapper.select: SELECT CAST(id AS CHAR) FROM tc_inventory_reservation WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND reservation_key=#{reservationKey}
SELECT id AS id,warehouse_id AS warehouse,sku_id AS sku,quantity AS quantity,status AS status FROM tc_inventory_reservation WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND reservation_key=#{reservationKey} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE tc_inventory_balance SET available=available+#{availableDelta},reserved=reserved-#{reservedDelta},sold=sold+#{soldDelta},version=version+1 WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND warehouse_id=#{warehouseId} AND sku_id=#{skuId} AND reserved>=#{minimumReserved}
UPDATE tc_inventory_reservation SET status=#{status},version=version+1 WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND id=#{reservationId}
mapper.select: SELECT id AS id,warehouse_id AS warehouseId,sku_id AS skuId,stock_total AS stockTotal,available AS available,reserved AS reserved,sold AS sold,version AS version FROM tc_inventory_balance WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND id>#{after} ORDER BY id LIMIT #{limit}
